# Journalism Finance v2.0.0

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on financial calculations and data fetching.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [adjustToInflation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/adjustToInflation.md): adjustToInflation function
- [decodeMonteCarloMonthlyIterations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/decodeMonteCarloMonthlyIterations.md): decodeMonteCarloMonthlyIterations function
- [decodeMonteCarloMonthlyQuantiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/decodeMonteCarloMonthlyQuantiles.md): decodeMonteCarloMonthlyQuantiles function
- [decodeMonteCarloValues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/decodeMonteCarloValues.md): decodeMonteCarloValues function
- [decodeMonteCarloWinners](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/decodeMonteCarloWinners.md): decodeMonteCarloWinners function
- [decodeMonteCarloWinnerSnapshots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/decodeMonteCarloWinnerSnapshots.md): decodeMonteCarloWinnerSnapshots function
- [getIncomeTax](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/getIncomeTax.md): getIncomeTax function
- [getLandTransferTax](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/getLandTransferTax.md): getLandTransferTax function
- [getMinimumDownPayment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/getMinimumDownPayment.md): getMinimumDownPayment function
- [getMortgagePenalty](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/getMortgagePenalty.md): getMortgagePenalty function
- [getRentVsBuyCholeskyMatrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/getRentVsBuyCholeskyMatrix.md): getRentVsBuyCholeskyMatrix function
- [getSalesTax](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/getSalesTax.md): getSalesTax function
- [getYahooFinanceData](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/getYahooFinanceData.md): getYahooFinanceData function
- [mortgageInsurancePremium](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/mortgageInsurancePremium.md): mortgageInsurancePremium function
- [mortgageMaxAmount](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/mortgageMaxAmount.md): mortgageMaxAmount function
- [mortgagePayments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/mortgagePayments.md): mortgagePayments function
- [simulateRentVsBuy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/simulateRentVsBuy.md): simulateRentVsBuy function
- [simulateRentVsBuyMonteCarlo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-finance/v2.0.0/docs/functions/simulateRentVsBuyMonteCarlo.md): simulateRentVsBuyMonteCarlo function
